title: "w02_Task3"
---


```{r}
library(gapminder)
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
nokuwait <- gapminder %>% filter(gapminder$country != "Kuwait")
```


```{r}
ggplot(nokuwait, mapping = aes(x = lifeExp, y = gdpPercap, color = continent, size = pop/100000)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(~ year, nrow = 1) +
  scale_y_continuous(trans = "sqrt") +
  theme_bw()
```
